problem: macOS says 'Mooziac is damaged and can't be opened. You should move it to the Trash' or developer cannot be verified
possible_causes: Mooziac is distributed outside the Mac App Store and without an Apple Developer ID paid notarization ticket.
macOS Gatekeeper attaches the quarantine extended attribute (com.apple.quarantine) to downloaded archives.
macOS Gatekeeper blocked execution upon first launch.
solutions: Open Terminal and run: xattr -cr /Applications/Mooziac.app to remove the quarantine flag.
Alternatively, right-click (or Control-click) Mooziac.app in Finder, select 'Open', and click 'Open' in the confirmation prompt.
Go to macOS System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down to the Security section, and click 'Open Anyway' next to the Mooziac notification.

problem: Trackpad Edge Volume gesture is not responding or changing volume
possible_causes: Swiping outside the active trigger zone (must be within the rightmost 2.5mm / x >= 0.982 of the trackpad).
Swiping started in the lower 70% of the trackpad (gesture requires starting in the top 30% / y >= 0.70).
Vertical movement was less than the 3.0mm activation threshold (designed to prevent typing accidents).
Using an external standard mouse or third-party trackpad that does not support Apple MultitouchSupport framework events.
Edge Volume is toggled off in Mooziac Settings > Gestures.
solutions: Place your finger on the extreme right edge of the MacBook trackpad in the top 30% region, then slide downward or upward smoothly.
Ensure you travel more than 3mm vertically to pass the anti-accidental-trigger deadzone.
Check Mooziac Settings > Gestures to confirm 'Enable Edge Volume' is switched ON.
Verify you are using a built-in MacBook trackpad or Apple Magic Trackpad (standard USB/Bluetooth mice do not emit multitouch digitizer packets).

problem: Downloaded track does not appear in local library or Downloads tab
possible_causes: The download failed or was interrupted mid-stream by network disconnection.
The standalone yt-dlp helper binary failed to download or execute in ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/.
The destination folder (~/Music/Mooziac/) has write permission restrictions or disk is full.
LocalDatabaseManager has not completed indexing the newly saved audio file into cached_tracks.
solutions: Open the Downloads tab in Mooziac and check if the track is flagged with a red failure badge; click Retry.
Check if ~/Music/Mooziac/ contains the downloaded file (.m4a, .mp3, or .opus). If the file exists there, select 'Rescan Library' from the File menu.
Verify your internet connection and ensure YouTube Music InnerTube did not rate-limit requests.
Check ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/yt-dlp exists and has executable permissions (chmod +x).

problem: Lyrics not showing or displaying 'No lyrics available'
possible_causes: Track lacks an entry on LRCLib (both exact duration lookup and fuzzy title/artist search failed).
YouTube Music InnerTube lyrics endpoint does not have synchronized or plain text lyrics for this track.
Track title contains complex metadata strings (e.g. '(Official Music Video)', '[Remastered 2024]') that confuse the search query.
For local tracks, no matching .lrc file exists beside the audio file or in ~/Music/Mooziac/.
Network connection is offline or blocking api.lrclib.net.
solutions: Check your internet connection to ensure LRCLib API is reachable.
For local audio files, download or create an .lrc file with the identical base filename (e.g., 'SongTitle.lrc' next to 'SongTitle.flac') and Mooziac will pick it up instantly.
If using YouTube Music, ensure the song title is clean; Mooziac automatically cleans common suffixes like '(Official Audio)', but very custom upload titles may not find matches.
Click the Lyrics button or toggle Cmd+Shift+L to force a fresh lyrics lookup.

problem: Lyrics out of sync with audio playback
possible_causes: The LRCLib or local .lrc timestamp offset does not match this specific audio edit (e.g., album version vs video version intro silence).
Audio stream buffering caused an initial playback timing discrepancy.
The matched lyrics belong to an alternative live or extended acoustic release.
solutions: Open the Centered Lyrics HUD and use the Lyrics Offset slider (or Cmd+[ and Cmd+]) to adjust timing in +/- 0.5s increments.
For local files, open the .lrc file in a text editor and adjust the global [offset:+/-ms] tag.
Clear cached lyrics for the track from ~/Library/Caches/Mooziac/Lyrics/ to allow Mooziac to re-fetch the best matching version.

problem: Discord Rich Presence does not update or shows nothing
possible_causes: The official Discord macOS desktop application is not running.
Discord Rich Presence is disabled in Mooziac Settings > Integrations.
All Discord native IPC domain sockets (/tmp/discord-ipc-0 through /tmp/discord-ipc-9) are occupied or unreadable.
Mooziac is running in 'Private Listening' mode.
Discord user has 'Share activity status with others' disabled in Discord User Settings > Activity Privacy.
solutions: Launch the Discord desktop app before or while running Mooziac.
Open Mooziac Settings (Cmd+,) > Integrations and ensure 'Discord Rich Presence' is toggled ON.
In Discord Settings > Activity Privacy, ensure 'Display current activity as a status message' is enabled.
Restart Discord and Mooziac to reconnect the local Unix domain socket /tmp/discord-ipc-0.

problem: Spacebar pauses music while typing in YouTube Music search box
possible_causes: Running Mooziac version v1.1.0 where global key interceptors caught the Space key before HTML web input elements could process it.
solutions: Update Mooziac to version v1.1.7 or newer where KeyboardCommandHandler explicitly checks first-responder focus on WKWebView input elements.
Click outside the search box or hit Enter to commit the search query before pressing Spacebar.

problem: Scrolling on Menu Bar item does not change volume
possible_causes: Running an earlier version where continuous trackpad scroll events in StatusItemManager did not trigger step increments.
Volume mode is set to an inactive audio route.
Scrolling was too light to exceed the 6-point trackpad threshold.
solutions: Update Mooziac to v1.1.7+ where scroll gesture handling was fully rewritten with discrete 6pt trackpad / mouse notch accumulation.
Place cursor over the Mooziac menu bar icon and swipe up or down firmly.
Verify in Settings > Audio whether App Volume or System Sound is selected.

problem: Settings panel text or controls are washed out or unreadable in Adaptive theme on macOS 27 beta
possible_causes: macOS 27 beta introduces altered dynamic semantic appearance inheritance where adaptive ambient colors clashed with light vibrancy materials.
solutions: Update Mooziac to v1.1.1+, which explicitly pins SettingsPanel to dark tone (.dark) regardless of host system beta quirks.
Switch to OLED Dark Mode or Pure Crystal Glass Mode in Settings > Appearance as an immediate workaround.

problem: YouTube Music page is blank, stuck loading, or showing network error
possible_causes: Internet connection is offline or unstable.
WebKit local cache or cookies became corrupt.
A corporate firewall, VPN, or DNS filter is blocking music.youtube.com.
Google anti-bot check triggered on the embedded WebKit instance.
solutions: Check internet connection and verify music.youtube.com opens in Safari.
Reload the page in Mooziac by pressing Cmd+R.
Clear Mooziac WebKit cache: Quit Mooziac, delete ~/Library/Caches/site.threeten.mooziac/, and relaunch.
Disconnect any VPNs or proxies that might interfere with Google's media CDNs.

problem: Google Sign-In blocked with 'Couldn't sign you in - This browser or app may not be secure'
possible_causes: Google blocks standard embedded WebKit/WKWebView web views from signing into Google accounts to prevent phishing.
The custom User-Agent string was reset or overridden.
solutions: Mooziac uses a modern desktop Safari User-Agent to comply with Google authentication requirements. Ensure you are on the latest version of Mooziac.
If 2-factor authentication fails via embedded browser, log into Google in your primary Safari browser first to establish a trusted device session, then log in via Mooziac.
Do not disable JavaScript or modify WebKit security settings.

problem: Local audio file fails to play or skips immediately to the next track
possible_causes: The audio file is in an unsupported or DRM-encrypted format (e.g. WMA, FairPlay AAC .m4p).
The file was moved, renamed, or deleted in Finder after being added to Mooziac.
Corrupted audio stream header causing AVFoundation to throw an initialization error.
File resides on an unmounted external drive or disconnected network share (SMB/NFS).
solutions: Ensure the audio file is one of the supported formats: FLAC, MP3, M4A, AAC, WAV, AIFF, AIF, OGG, or OPUS.
Verify the file is still present at its original path in Finder and that external storage drives are mounted.
Test playing the file in QuickTime Player or VLC to confirm the audio stream is not corrupted.
Remove and re-add the track or folder in Mooziac's local library.

problem: Audio automatically pauses unexpectedly during playback
possible_causes: AirPods, Bluetooth headphones, or external DAC disconnected, causing AudioRouteMonitor to trigger safety auto-pause.
Another application requested exclusive CoreAudio output or system audio was muted.
The Mac entered system sleep or display sleep.
Track finished and Repeat mode was OFF and Queue was empty.
solutions: Check your headphone Bluetooth connection or battery level.
Press Spacebar or Play in Mooziac after reconnecting audio output devices.
Verify queue has upcoming tracks and repeat mode is set as desired in the playback toolbar.

problem: Mooziac main window disappeared but audio keeps playing
possible_causes: The main window was closed using the red traffic light button (Mooziac continues playing in the menu bar).
The app was launched or switched into 'Menu Bar Only Mode' (Hide Dock Icon).
Window minimized to Dock or hidden via Cmd+H.
solutions: Click the Mooziac icon in the macOS menu bar at the top of your screen to show controls or reopen the window.
Click the Mooziac Dock icon (if visible) to bring the main window to the front.
Press Cmd+1 or use the menu bar item 'Show Main Window'.

problem: Loudness Normalization makes music sound too quiet or muffled
possible_causes: Loudness Normalization is actively targeting -14 LUFS, which attenuates modern hyper-compressed 'loudness war' masterings.
App Volume slider is set lower than 100% inside Mooziac.
solutions: Open Mooziac Settings > Audio and uncheck 'Loudness Normalization' to listen to the unattenuated raw audio stream.
Check that Mooziac's internal volume slider is set to 100% and adjust your Mac's master volume instead.

problem: Corner tap gestures trigger accidentally while typing or moving the cursor
possible_causes: Resting palms or thumb touching within the bottom 15% corners (y <= 0.15) of the trackpad.
Accidental multi-tap detection due to trackpad sensitivity.
solutions: Go to Mooziac Settings > Gestures and disable 'Enable Corner Tap Triggers'.
Alternatively, re-map corner tap triggers to 'None' or less disruptive actions.
Maintain typing posture keeping palms off the extreme lower corners of the trackpad.

problem: Mooziac icon missing from macOS menu bar
possible_causes: The menu bar is crowded with too many status icons, and macOS hid Mooziac behind the MacBook notch.
Menu bar item was disabled in Mooziac Settings.
solutions: Close or hide unused third-party menu bar items to make space.
Use menu bar utilities like Ice or Bartender to organize icons around the notch.
Verify in Mooziac Settings > General that 'Show in Menu Bar' is enabled.

problem: Centered Lyrics HUD covers active window content or full-screen video
possible_causes: CenteredMenuBarLyricsWindowController uses a floating borderless window level (.floating / .statusBar) so it remains visible above normal windows.
Lyrics HUD was left visible during video playback.
solutions: Press Cmd+Shift+L to immediately dismiss the lyrics HUD.
Perform a 3-tap gesture in the bottom-left corner of the trackpad to toggle HUD visibility.
In Mooziac Settings > Lyrics, set the HUD to auto-hide when Mooziac is not playing.

problem: FLAC audio plays but local .lrc lyrics file in the same folder does not load
possible_causes: The .lrc file name does not match the FLAC file name exactly (case-sensitive check before extension).
The .lrc file is encoded with ANSI / Windows-1252 / UTF-16 instead of standard UTF-8.
The .lrc file is in a different folder than the audio file and not in ~/Music/Mooziac/.
solutions: Ensure the .lrc file has the exact same base name as the audio file (e.g. 'Track01.flac' and 'Track01.lrc').
Open the .lrc file in a text editor and re-save it with UTF-8 encoding.
Keep the .lrc file in the same folder as the FLAC file, or place it in ~/Music/Mooziac/.

problem: High CPU usage or battery drain on older Intel MacBooks
possible_causes: Using the 'Waveform' progress bar style which renders continuous 32-bar reactive animations.
Running multiple animated theme layers simultaneously on an integrated Intel Iris/HD GPU.
solutions: Switch Progress Bar Style to 'Minimal Line' in Settings > Appearance.
Switch Theme to 'OLED Dark Mode' or disable ambient glow effects.
Update to latest Mooziac version which includes optimized AppKit drawing pipelines.

problem: Downloads fail immediately with 'Helper binary not found' or execution error
possible_causes: DependencyManager failed to download the yt-dlp binary due to a captive portal, firewall, or GitHub downtime.
The downloaded binary at ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/yt-dlp was corrupted or lacks executable permissions (+x).
solutions: Verify your internet connection can reach https://github.com.
Open Terminal and run: chmod +x ~/Library/Application\ Support/Mooziac/bin/yt-dlp
Delete ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/bin/yt-dlp and restart Mooziac to trigger a clean auto-download.

problem: Listening history is not being saved or playlists are missing
possible_causes: 'Save Listening History' is disabled in Mooziac Settings > Privacy.
The SQLite database at ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/mooziac.sqlite is locked or file permissions are broken.
The user opened Mooziac in Guest user or temporary directory.
solutions: Open Mooziac Settings > Privacy and ensure 'Save Listening History' is enabled.
Check permissions on ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/ and ensure your user account has read/write access.
If the SQLite file is corrupted, backup existing files and delete ~/Library/Application Support/Mooziac/mooziac.sqlite; Mooziac will recreate a clean database schema on next launch.

problem: Audio sounds distorted, crackly, or clipping at high volume
possible_causes: Both Mooziac App Volume and macOS System Sound are pushed beyond 0 dB using third-party sound boosters (e.g. Boom 3D, SoundSource).
An audio driver sample rate mismatch between CoreAudio and a USB DAC.
solutions: Enable 'Loudness Normalization' in Mooziac Settings > Audio to clamp peak audio levels to -14 LUFS.
Disable software gain boosters or pre-amps in third-party audio utility apps.
Open macOS Audio MIDI Setup (in Utilities) and ensure your output device sample rate is set to 44.1 kHz or 48.0 kHz.

problem: Mooziac crashes on launch with an OS incompatibility message
possible_causes: Running macOS 12 Monterey, macOS 11 Big Sur, or older. Mooziac requires macOS 13.0 Ventura or later due to modern AppKit, Swift Concurrency, and WebKit APIs.
solutions: Upgrade your Mac to macOS 13 Ventura, macOS 14 Sonoma, or macOS 15 Sequoia.
Check macOS version in Apple menu () > About This Mac.

problem: Global Hotkey shortcuts (Cmd+Option+Space) do not trigger when Mooziac is in the background
possible_causes: Another running application (like Alfred, Raycast, or Zoom) has registered the identical global key combination.
Input Monitoring or Accessibility permissions were revoked in macOS System Settings.
solutions: Check for hotkey conflicts in other running utilities.
Ensure Mooziac has necessary permissions in macOS System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility if prompted.
Use the menu bar item or trackpad corner tap gestures to control playback without conflicting with global keyboard hooks.
